messages.subject: Generate null model for model fit comparison with bandit2arm_delta()
messages.subject_clean: Generate null model for model fit comparison with bandit2arm_delta()
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

I'm an hBayesDM newbie, and I'm interested in comparing the model fit for a model produced by the bandit2arm_delta() function against a model in which subjects decide between the two choices at random (i.e., a null model in which there is no learning involved). My goal here is to compare these two models and foreclose on the hypothesis that subjects are simply making their choices randomly. My intuition is that the code for bandit2arm_delta() can be augmented to accomplish this, but I'm not exactly sure how.

Does anyone have any idea how I might go about doing this, or otherwise have any suggestions? Thank you!

Best,

Thomas McCauley
Ph.D. student
Department of Psychology
University of California, San Diego
